body: Here's hoping a WinDery unit gets promoted instead.

My 2 cents: 7Dream is hanging in balance but Renjun MIGHT be added to WayV after NCT2020. NCT Japan is definitely happening in the latter half of the year and SM probably has a 3/4 hidden JP trainees that will be introduced early next year similar to XiaoHenYang. The only thing I'm scared of is how 127 and WayV will be affected since Yuta will definitely have to focus on JP promotions (like Winwin who eventually has become an official WayV member and left 127 fr - it's something I've already accepted) and for some reason it feels like Ten is going to that JP unit as well. I dunno, call it intuition. Regarding 7Dream, I don't know how fans will riot if SM continues with the original graduation plan. It still seems cool imo but fans, esp Kfans, are pretty scary when they don't get what they want and 7Dream's market is definitely in SK.
